package.scope: Read-only inspection of the isolated package also copied by the failed native lifecycle fixture. The manifest identifies the package; the lifecycle harness itself labels its input as an existing local package.

inspection.method: Package-bundled Mono.Cecil reads metadata and IL; target game assemblies are not loaded or executed
inspection.setter_search_scope: Method-reference operands named SetAttemptLimits in all method bodies, including nested types, in the three identified assemblies

native_contract.scope: New TCP attempts from one source IP at a Fleck WebSocket listener
native_contract.rejection_stage: Before HTTP upgrade and command delivery
native_contract.rejection_behavior: Close the accepted socket and return, without an HTTP error response, WebSocket error frame or limit-specific log message

il_references.finding: Reads UtcNow; initializes a new window with count 0; resets only when elapsed > window; otherwise increments the count and rejects count >= 5, before checking the per-IP active-connection limit
Decrements active and overall connection counts; an IP entry is removed only when it has zero active connections and its attempt window has strictly expired
Creates ConnectionLimiter and overrides only the concurrent connection limits through SetConnectionLimits; does not override the attempt window
Calls TryAdd with RemoteIpAddress; failure calls ISocket.Close and exits before constructing the WebSocket connection
Closes the stream and underlying socket

completed_checks.manual_save_receipt: One production save dispatch, no retry, matching instance/run/session, response present, save_completion=requested
completed_checks.native_save_log: Saved 420 entities followed by Saving complete; this is a native completion log, not a backup-restore or exact content-readback result

failure.stage: Reading the WebSocket HTTP upgrade response
failure.call_sequence: Four separate successful RCON queries, then one successful manual-save connection, followed by the shutdown save connection
failure.assessment: The sixth-connection failure matches the verified native five-attempt window and the former one-connection-per-command production path. The original run did not capture per-connection arrival timestamps or a native limit event; the limit trigger is a diagnosis supported by the call sequence and static native contract, not a packet-capture claim.

cleanup.interpretation: Reported by test-owned cleanup after shutdown failed; it is not evidence of a spontaneous native server crash or a successful normal stop
cleanup.fixture_files: Removed after owned-process cleanup was confirmed; the original server.cfg was not retained

map_cache_filename_interpretation.local_map_filename_contrast: World::get_MapFileName reads World.Seed at IL_0077 for the ordinary local filename
map_cache_filename_interpretation.scope: The uploaded-cache URL does not show that configured seed 11072026 was lost. The initial fixture's actual seed was not independently read back before cleanup.

manager_correction.connection_policy: Process-wide admission keyed by parsed endpoint, with five slots. In-flight slots remain occupied until the TCP stream is dropped. Completed successful and failed attempts retain their slots until both monotonic and UTC elapsed time are strictly greater than five seconds.
manager_correction.scope: Waiting occurs before connecting or sending. It does not change commands, passwords, server limits or the native configuration readback helper. Other clients using the same source IP can still consume the server's allowance.

scope: This artifact records static native behavior, the initial failed lifecycle observation and the implemented correction. It does not establish a passing post-fix build, unit suite, native lifecycle, Source RCON run, client join or performance result. Later validation is recorded separately. Credentials, instance identifiers, machine names and absolute task paths are omitted.
